ISS-001.title: Posts API has no response caching; dead cache code removed
ISS-001.description: RIL.md debt item #6: posts_cache/cached() decorator removed as dead code; /api/posts and details are uncached. A dict-serialized cache would be a real perf win but needs cross-session detachment handling.

ISS-002.title: Slug validation allows free-form slugs breaking feed/sitemap URLs
ISS-002.description: RIL.md debt item #7 (L8 backend): no pattern constraint on Post.slug; free-form slugs can produce broken feed/sitemap URLs. Needs migration-safe pattern enforcement.

ISS-003.title: CI not verified green after local-only fixes
ISS-003.description: RIL.md debt item #1: local main is 9 commits ahead with CI fixes (pnpm cache path, Node 24, proxy specs); CI can't be verified green until pushed. e2e suite needs full local run confirmation post-fixes.

ISS-004.title: Admin comment delete returns 500 on PostgreSQL
ISS-004.description: From python-reviewer findings (M2 backend correctness): admin comment delete could raise unhandled IntegrityError producing 500; check if fully resolved and tested on PG semantics.

HYP-001.title: posts-list API is bottlenecked by uncached DB reads on the most trafficked endpoint
HYP-001.description: /api/posts is the hottest public endpoint; caching the list with a TTL would reduce DB load. Risk: SQLAlchemy ORM objects detach across sessions — cache must store serialized dicts.

EV-001.title: get_posts performs uncached DB read (count + eager load)
EV-001.content: crud.get_posts does query.count() then order_by().offset().limit().all() with joinedload — no cache layer. Returns live ORM objects tied to the request Session.

TASK-001.title: Add TTL response cache for posts list endpoint
TASK-001.description: Implement a per-process TTL cache for get_posts returning serialized dicts (avoid ORM detach). Invalidate on post create/update/delete and publish_at changes. Add tests for cache hit/miss and invalidation.

TASK-002.title: Enforce slug pattern on Post schema
TASK-002.description: Add regex pattern constraint to PostBase/ Post schema slug field (^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$). Add migration-safe handling. Tests for invalid slugs rejected.

TASK-003.title: Verify admin comment-delete error handling against PostgreSQL
TASK-003.description: Read admin.py comment delete path and crud; confirm IntegrityError is caught and returns 400 (not 500) on PG with FK-restricted orphaned replies. Add/restore test covering this.

TASK-004.title: Run local test/lint suites to confirm CI-green state
TASK-004.description: Run backend pytest + ruff and frontend vitest + biome locally to confirm the 9 unpushed CI-fix commits actually pass on this environment, recording evidence. (Push to main deferred — human-in-the-loop per stop conditions.)

EV-002.title: Handler logic verified via mocked IntegrityError commit; route returns 400 + rollback
EV-002.content: admin_delete_comment (admin.py:567) catches IntegrityError, calls db.rollback(), raises HTTPException(400). Verified the ORM-cascade masking issue (SQLAlchemy nulls child parent_id before DELETE when children tracked in-session) is why a real FK-triggered IntegrityError is DB-dependent on the delete path; mocked commit to isolate handler logic. FK pragma enabled globally in conftest (523 tests pass).

HYP-002.title: admin delete-comment-with-replies is protected against 500
HYP-002.description: admin_delete_comment (admin.py:556-575) catches IntegrityError from FK violation on reply-referenced parent, rolls back, returns 400. Verified via mocked-commit test EV-002.

EV-003.title: PostUpdate now rejects malformed slugs; PostBase pattern verified with tests
EV-003.content: Added Field(pattern=SLUG_PATTERN.pattern) to PostUpdate.slug (schemas.py:79). PostBase.slug already had the pattern (line 57) but was untested; added test_post_base_INVALID_slug_rejected + test_post_base_valid_slug_accepted. admin.py:241 only applies slug when not None, so API boundary now rejects invalid slugs on create/update returning 422. 59 schema tests + 126 admin+schema tests pass.

DEC-001.title: Enforce SLUG_PATTERN on both PostCreate and PostUpdate
DEC-001.rationale: PostUpdate.slug had no pattern, allowing broken feed/sitemap URLs via the update endpoint. Reusing the existing SLUG_PATTERN constant (not a new regex) keeps a single source of truth. None remains valid (means 'do not update').
DEC-001.alternatives_rejected: Add a separate validator function; create a new regex (drift risk)

CHG-001.title: Enforce slug pattern on PostUpdate
CHG-001.description: Added Field(pattern=SLUG_PATTERN.pattern) to PostUpdate.slug + tests for PostBase/PostUpdate slug validation

EV-004.source: backend/nova/app/cache.py: posts_list_cache + clear_posts_list_cache; posts.py list_posts; crud.py write invalidation
EV-004.title: Posts list caching implemented and verified
EV-004.content: Added posts_list_cache (TTLCache ttl=300, maxsize=256) storing serialized PostListResponse dicts keyed by (page,limit,category_id,tag_id). list_posts returns cached dict on hit (verified crud.get_posts called once for 2 identical requests). Invalidation (clear_posts_list_cache) on create_post/update_post/delete_post — matching existing clear_tags_cache pattern. Did NOT invalidate on increment_views/likes (they don't affect list ordering/content). Autouse fixture clears cache per-test. Full backend suite: 545 passed, 8 skipped. SQLite FK pragma enabled to match PG semantics.

EV-005.title: Local CI-green state confirmed (backend+frontend+lint)
EV-005.content: Backend: 545 passed, 8 skipped (pytest-xdist). Frontend: 678 passed (38 files, vitest). Lint: ruff check+format clean (backend); biome check clean 110 files (frontend). NOTE: origin/main is still 9 commits unpushed (RIL.md debt #1); pushing to main/main requires human confirmation per stop condition #1, so ISS-003 (CI green on remote) is NOT fully resolved — only the local state is verified green.

DEC-002.title: CI green confirmation is local-only; remote push deferred to human
DEC-002.rationale: Graph-engineering stop condition #1 requires human confirmation before push to main. Local suites verified green, but origin/main remote CI cannot turn green until the commits are pushed by a human. This is recorded as a deferral, not a resolution.

HYP-003.title: Local test/lint suites are green after the 9 unpushed CI-fix commits
HYP-003.description: If local green holds, ISS-003 is unblocked only by the human push step (DEC-003 deferral).

ISS-005.title: Admin post update/delete routes bypass crud and skip cache invalidation
ISS-005.description: Admin API routes (admin_update_post/admin_delete_post) do direct ORM writes instead of calling crud.update_post/delete_post, so the posts list cache was never invalidated on admin writes — the test_list_posts_cache_invalidated_on_{update,delete} tests caught this. Fixed by adding clear_tags_cache()+clear_posts_list_cache() after commit in both routes.

EV-006.title: Admin write routes now invalidate posts_list_cache after commit; tests confirm
EV-006.content: Before fix, admin_update_post/admin_delete_post did db.commit() with no cache clear (crud has the invalidation, but admin routes bypass crud). Added clear_tags_cache()+clear_posts_list_cache() after commit in both routes. test_list_posts_cache_invalidated_on_update (updates title, cache reflects new value) and test_list_posts_cache_invalidated_on_delete (count goes 1->0) now pass. Full suite green.

CHG-002.title: Complete cache invalidation + ril hardening + review fixes
CHG-002.description: Removed posts.py dead code; added admin-route cache invalidation; ril.py commit/source string validation; repaired CHG-001; docstring updates.
